notes.title: Developer Tree Time TS22/23
notes.content:
By request, on April 5th, 7 PM UTC I, the developer will be hosting a Developer Tree Time for Tree Simulator 2023. Someone in the Discord has volunteered to host Tree Simulator 2022. 

[h2]Goals of the event[/h2]
[list]
[*] Get the achievements (and stick around for others!)
[*] Trees get to talk to the developer.
[*] I will likely talk about the upcoming release of Nautikin Adventures.
[*] I might give away keys if you tell me a story or something.
[/list]
For TS2023 you will be able to join via the server browser by connecting to "Developer Tree Time"

For TS2022 you may need to add whoever is hosting Steam in order to join directly (depends on profile settings), or join someone already in the lobby. There will likely be a steam join link available during the event.

[h3][b]In the mean time you can check out Nautikin Adventures on Steam:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244830/Nautikin_Adventures/

notes.title: Developer Tree Time TS2022/2023
notes.content:
On January 28th, 7 PM UTC I will be hosting another [b]Developer Tree Time[/b] for Tree Simulator 2022 and 2023

[h1]Goals of the event[/h1]
[list]
[*] Unlock / Test TS2023 100 tree forest achievement for those that requested it at the last event
[*] Test new lobby limit for TS2022 which makes it easier to get the 100 forest achievement
[*] Trees get to talk to the developer
[*] I might talk about my new game and whatever else trees want to talk about.
[/list]
For TS2022 you may need to add me on Steam in order to join directly, or join someone already in the lobby. 

For TS2023 you will be able to join via server browser by connecting to "Developer Tree Time"

Wishlist my new game to support my efforts until then, spread the word if you can:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244830/Nautikin_Adventures/

notes.title: Multiplayer limit increase
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the limit of multiplayer lobbies to 250
[/list]
[h1]Notes[/h1]
This change was requested during yesterdays event. The goal of this change is to make it easier for trees to reach the 100 tree forest achievement and not prevent more than 100 trees from joining. Because of the original intent, only 100 trees will ever spawn, after 100 more players will join the lobby but the number of physical trees will remain the same.

I have not really tested this because I do not have 100 computers, but I may schedule another "Developer tree time" event for TS2023 and TS2022 at the same time for the purposes of testing this achievement, achieving it for those who requested it yesterday and probably talking about my new game which everyone should wishlist to support my work in general. The amount of time I can spend on TS2024 development next year will be directly affected by my work on this game, so please be patient, it will likely be later in the year if / when I can spend time on it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244830/Nautikin_Adventures/?curator_clanid=41985425
